entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 9
Case :- Writ - C No. - 11279 of 2020
Petitioner :- Gurumal Singh

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shailesh Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for all the respondents.
The petitioner is a proprietor of Sardar Dhaba and he is running his business since 1993.
The license in this regard was also granted in favour of the petitioner by the competent authority in the year 1993 itself.

Apart from the same, the department of Food Safety and Drug Administration,
Government of U.P. also issued a license in favour of the petitioner in terms of the provisions contained under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
It is stated that wholly illegally the property of the Dhaba in question was attached under Section 83 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
On an application filed by the petitioner, the Chief Judicial Magistrate,Bhadohi Gyanpur released the property vide order dated 07.02.2020.

After the aforesaid order was passed and after lockdown was over, when the petitioner tried to open his Dhaba, the Officer-In Charge of Police Station Aurai District Sant Ravidas Nagar came to Dhaba on the petitioner on 07.06.2020 and forcibly shutdown Gurumal Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 7 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15317503/
1 the same.

entities.text: Police Station Aurai District Sant Ravidas Nagar
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Gurumal Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Aggrieved against the aforesaid action, a representation was submitted by the petitioner addressed to the Superintendent of Police, Bhadohi on 08.06.2020, copy of which is appended as Annexure No.9 to the writ petition.
It is argued that in spite of the fact that a considerable time has been lapsed, till date no final decision has been taken on the same.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the issue, the present petition stands disposed of finally permitting the petitioner to submit fresh representation ventilating all his grievances along with copy of earlier representation dated 08.06.2020 and self attested computer generated copy of this order downloaded from the official website of High Court Allahabad before respondent No.2 within a period of two weeks from today.

If such a representation is filed within stipulated period as mentioned above, the respondent No.2 shall pass appropriate orders on the same in accordance with law expeditiously and preferably within a period of four weeks from the date of submission of representation before him.
